title: Laboratory Testing for Salmonella | Salmonella Infection | CDC
content: August 22, 2024 Laboratory Testing for Salmonella What to know CDC offers confirmatory identification, serotyping, and subtyping of Salmonella recovered from normally sterile sites. CDC accepts specimens for analysis only from state public health laboratories and other federal agencies. Private healthcare providers and institutions must submit specimens to their state public health laboratory for processing.
